items.title: Git server on object storage
items.oneliner: Single-binary Git server stores repos on S3 or GCS with LFS and smart HTTP, avoiding traditional Git hosting overhead.

items.title: Self-hosted ebook library on object storage
items.oneliner: Browser-based EPUB and PDF library runs on Cloudflare Workers or Node, giving you a lightweight self-hosted reading stack.

items.title: Tiny complete Windows app in assembly
items.oneliner: Study multiple byte-minimized Windows executables to learn message loops, UI plumbing, and extreme binary size optimization.

items.title: UEFI bootable BASIC interpreter
items.oneliner: GW-BASIC compatible interpreter boots on bare metal UEFI machines and Windows, with graphics, arrays, and filesystem access.

items.title: Persistent agent microharness
items.oneliner: Open-source Bash harness keeps agents running continuously, useful for testing autonomous loops, priorities, and shell-driven workflows.

items.title: Deep dive into QR code art
items.oneliner: Hands-on guide explains QR structure, error correction, and design tradeoffs so you can make stylized codes that still scan.

items.title: Reinforcement learning for code art
items.oneliner: Detailed build log shows how to train a model to generate JavaScript sketches using reward models and rendered outputs.

items.title: Inference engine attack surface explained
items.oneliner: Security walkthrough shows how LLM outputs can exploit buggy inference engines, with concrete examples practitioners should threat model.

items.title: Reverse engineering Paint image watermarking
items.oneliner: Technical teardown shows how Microsoft embeds hidden GUID watermarks and C2PA metadata into locally generated images.

items.title: What changed in Emacs 31.1
items.oneliner: Practical release walkthrough covers the portable dumper shift and quality-of-life changes worth knowing before upgrading editor setups.
